name: Lead Sniper | Cloud / Setup and Authenticated Preflight

parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json;if(r.statusCode!==200||!Array.isArray(r.body))throw new Error('Authenticated stargazer listing failed: HTTP '+r.statusCode+'; inspect GitHub permissions or rate-limit headers');return [{json:{ok:true}}];
throw new Error('GitHub preflight transport failed; check the credential and connection before activating');
const rows=$input.all().filter(i=>i.json.id);if(rows.length>1)throw new Error('Duplicate control rows: stop and resolve before activation');return [{json:{exists:rows.length===1}}];

parameters.content: No external database. Select GitHub credentials in both HTTP nodes, then run this once. It verifies authenticated access and creates three internal Data Tables without resetting an existing cutoff. Keep inactive.
